patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff does not apply to the regressed vulnerable checkout bundled in n132/arvo:33781-vul, so fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative n132/arvo:33781-fix image. That real fixed source carries the same repair at include/jsoncons/json_encoder.hpp:106 (`it = r.ptr - 1`), and the instrumented fixed run stays clean while still reaching the frozen root event with the satisfied cursor relation.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `unicode_traits::to_codepoint()` returns the first unread byte in `r.ptr`, `escape_string()` must store the loop cursor back into `it` as the last byte of the decoded code point (`it == r.ptr - 1`) so the surrounding `for (...; ++it)` header performs the single intended advance.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the crashing vulnerable path, the final key byte is a one-byte DEL code point, so `r.ptr == end`. The vulnerable original writes `it = r.ptr`, leaving the loop cursor already at the slice end before the header increment executes; the fixed build reaches the same source point with `it == r.ptr - 1` instead.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable assertion trace records `cursor_rewrite.it_after_assign != cursor_rewrite.safe_cursor_after_decode`, while the authoritative fixed image records equality at the same source event and does not emit any post-slice sink event.

nodes.state: At the first later execution of the frame-0 sink statement `CharT c = *it;` after the bad cursor rewrite, the vulnerable original dereferences with `it > end`, so the same source sink is already reading past the key slice before the later container-overflow instance on that line reaches the reader buffer boundary.
nodes.evidence: In the vulnerable original trace, `post_slice_deref.it_ptr > post_slice_deref.key_end_ptr`.

edges.relation: The exact cursor value written by the buggy `it = r.ptr` assignment becomes the immediate predecessor of the first later `*it` execution with `it > end`, showing that the loop header advanced the same stored iterator one step past the key bound.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original trace, `cursor_rewrite.it_after_assign == post_slice_deref.previous_it_ptr`.
